Class Task

java.lang.Object
com.taskflow.model.Task
public class Task extends Object
A single to-do item.

The lab requires each task to have a title, a description and a status. TaskFlow additionally stores a Priority, an optional due date and creation / update timestamps. Identity is defined by the numeric id only, so two snapshots of the same task are considered equal even if their text differs.

This class is a plain data holder: it does not validate its fields. Validation lives in com.taskflow.service.TaskService so that every code path shares the same rules.

  • Constructor Details

    • Task

      public Task(int id, String title, String description, TaskStatus status, Priority priority, LocalDate dueDate, LocalDateTime createdAt, LocalDateTime updatedAt)
      Creates a task with every field supplied. Used when loading saved tasks and when copying.
      Parameters:
      id - the unique identifier
      title - the short title
      description - the longer description; null is stored as an empty string
      status - the current status; null is stored as TaskStatus.PENDING
      priority - the importance; null is stored as Priority.MEDIUM
      dueDate - the optional due date; null means "no due date"
      createdAt - when the task was created
      updatedAt - when the task was last modified
